parameters.description: Only include sections containing this text. Defaults to no text filter; combine with section_types to narrow the match.

parameters.name: section_types
parameters.description: Only include sections of these types, combined with contains_text when supplied. Defaults to no type filter; omit rather than send an empty array.

tools.name: SearchContent
tools.description:
Search accessible Slack messages, files, channels or people, including unjoined channels,
through Slack real-time search. Requires Slack AI availability.

Classic message/file search works without that feature. Follow next_cursor for more matches;
selected references can be used to read exact messages, threads, files or profiles.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search nonempty text or Slack modifiers such as in:channel, from:user and has:file, up to 5,000 characters. Use Slack channel/user names or IDs inside modifiers rather than JSON field names.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA zone for posted_at values. Defaults to UTC.

parameters.name: content_types
parameters.description: Only return matches of these resource types. Defaults to messages when omitted; an empty array is not accepted.

parameters.name: channel_types
parameters.description: Only search conversations of these types. Defaults to all conversation types when omitted; an empty array is not accepted.

parameters.name: include_bots
parameters.description: Include bot messages and users. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: include_deleted_users
parameters.description: Include deactivated users. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Search archived channels. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Rank by relevance score or message time. Defaults to score; use order for the direction.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order the chosen ranking from highest/newest to lowest/oldest when descending, or the reverse when ascending. Defaults to descending.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only include results after this ISO 8601 date and time with an explicit UTC offset or Z; must not exceed before. Defaults to an empty string, with no lower bound.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only include results before this ISO 8601 date and time with an explicit UTC offset or Z. Defaults to an empty string, with no upper bound.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per Slack page, 1-20. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass next_cursor unchanged from SearchContent with every other search input unchanged, including limit and timezone. Defaults to an empty string for the first page; restart if the result set changed.

output.description: Accessible message, file, channel and user matches with source references.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass next_cursor unchanged from SearchEmojis with the same query. Restart without it if the workspace's emoji set changed. Defaults to an empty string for the first page.

tools.name: SearchUsers
tools.description:
Find matching people and return all visible candidates rather than choosing an ambiguous
name. Text matches keep Slack's order and may span next_cursor; an exact ID/email lookup
returns at most one account. A selected user ID can identify a profile or participants when
opening a conversation.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Match a U- or W-prefixed user ID, exact email, or case-insensitive substring in names, handles and email, up to 300 characters; a leading @ is ignored. Text search excludes deactivated users.

parameters.name: include_bots
parameters.description: Include bot and app accounts. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return up to this many matches, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass next_cursor unchanged from a text SearchUsers call with the same query and include_bots filter. Exact ID/email lookups do not accept a cursor. Defaults to an empty string for the first page.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
Send messages now, including thread replies, and return each posted reference or failure.

For later delivery, schedule a message instead. For outcome_unknown, read destination
history or the target thread before resending; retrying the whole batch can duplicate
successful posts.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: Send 1-20 messages in input order, each with its own destination, text and optional thread parent. Inspect every indexed result; one failure does not stop later items.

tools.name: UploadFile
tools.description:
Upload supplied content or open a local file picker without uploading anything.

Omit text and content_base64 to choose a file in an App-capable client. FileReader sends
its bytes directly to this tool after the user confirms; the model receives only the
result references. Client code may supply text or base64 explicitly, up to 8 MiB.
Opening or cancelling the picker creates no Slack file and posts no message.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Name supplied text/bytes with 1-255 characters and no path separators or control characters. Defaults to an empty string so the App can use the selected local file's name; supplied content needs a filename.

parameters.name: conversation
parameters.description: Share in an existing C-, G- or D-prefixed conversation ID or exact channel name with or without #. User selectors do not open DMs. Defaults to an empty string, keeping the file private; thread_ts/comment need a conversation.

parameters.name: thread_ts
parameters.description: Share under this parent Slack timestamp in seconds.microseconds format, in conversation. Do not supply a permalink or conversation_id:timestamp reference. Defaults to an empty string, sharing outside a thread.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Upload this UTF-8 text as a file, mutually exclusive with content_base64; encoded size must be 1 byte to 8 MiB. Defaults to omitted; omitting both content fields opens the file picker.

parameters.name: content_base64
parameters.description: Upload these standard base64 bytes, mutually exclusive with text; decoded size must be 1 byte to 8 MiB. Client code must read local bytes; do not invent encoded content. Defaults to omitted; omitting both content fields opens the file picker.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Post this initial comment with the file, up to 4,000 characters; requires conversation. Defaults to an empty string, posting no comment.

documentationChunks.content:
<Callout type="info" title="Channel creation not supported">
Managing channels in Slack requires the `channels:manage` scope, which is only available with bot tokens. Arcade uses user tokens (the type of token Arcade supports), so creating new channels is not possible with this toolkit. You can invite users to an existing channel, but channel creation is not supported.
</Callout>

summary:
Arcade's Slack toolkit provides LLM-callable tools for interacting with Slack workspaces. It enables agents to read and write messages, threads, files, canvases, lists, reactions, channels, and user profiles through the Slack API.

## Capabilities

- **Messaging & scheduling:** Send, edit, delete, forward, and schedule messages; post thread replies; cancel pending scheduled messages; mark conversations as read.
- **Channels, DMs & members:** Create and list conversations (channels, DMs, group DMs); invite users; list and resolve members; retrieve conversation metadata.
- **Files & canvases:** Upload, finalize, download, and search files; create, read, update, delete, and share canvases; search canvas sections for targeted edits.
- **Lists & records:** Create and update lists with typed column schemas; add, update, and delete records; replace list schemas with incremental record migration.
- **Search & discovery:** Search messages, files, channels, people, and custom emoji (classic and Slack AI–powered search); look up user profiles with full detail.
- **Reactions, pins & identity:** Add or remove reactions; list pinned items; check authenticated identity; enumerate workspace users and their profiles.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses OAuth 2.0 via the **Slack** provider. See the [Arcade Slack auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/slack) for configuration details.
